sub_unit_name: External treatment methods - Softening of water by ion-exchange processes

content.title: External Water Treatment
content.description: External treatment removes hardness-producing ions from water before it enters the boiler. The ion-exchange process is one of the most efficient methods for producing soft and demineralized water.

content.content: External treatment is carried out outside the boiler to remove dissolved calcium (Ca2+) and magnesium (Mg2+) ions that cause hardness. The ion-exchange process replaces these ions with hydrogen (H+) and hydroxyl (OH-) ions to produce soft water suitable for industrial applications.

content.title: Why External Treatment?
content.content: It prevents scale formation, improves boiler efficiency, reduces maintenance costs, and increases the life of boiler equipment.

The ion-exchange process is based on the exchange of undesirable ions present in water with harmless ions attached to synthetic resins. Cation exchange resins replace positive ions, while anion exchange resins replace negative ions.

The cation exchange resin contains acidic functional groups (R-H). It exchanges hydrogen ions (H+) for hardness-producing ions such as Ca2+ and Mg2+.

2RH + Ca2+ → R2Ca + 2H+

The anion exchange resin contains basic functional groups (R-OH). It exchanges hydroxyl ions (OH-) for chloride, sulfate, bicarbonate, and nitrate ions present in water.

R-OH + Cl- → R-Cl + OH-

items.question: Complete Softening
items.answer: Removes almost all dissolved cations and anions.

items.question: High Purity Water
items.answer: Produces demineralized water suitable for high-pressure boilers.

items.question: Low Maintenance
items.answer: Resins can be regenerated and reused multiple times.

items.question: Wide Industrial Use
items.answer: Used in power plants, pharmaceuticals, and chemical industries.

right_points: Feed water should be free from suspended impurities

content.title: Applications
content.content: The ion-exchange process is widely used in thermal power plants, laboratories, pharmaceutical industries, electronics manufacturing, and chemical processing plants.

content.title: Quick Revision
points: External treatment removes hardness before water enters the boiler.
Cation resin exchanges Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺ with H⁺ ions.
Anion resin exchanges Cl⁻, SO₄²⁻, and other anions with OH⁻ ions.
H⁺ and OH⁻ combine to form pure water.
Ion-exchange produces highly purified demineralized water.
